#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
BUILD_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/build"
SRC_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/src"
HARDWARE_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/src/hardware"
GPU_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/src/gpu"
PARALLEL_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/src/parallel"
LIB_NAME="libjaide_v35.so"
VERIFICATION_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/src/verification"
ZK_DIR="${BUILD_DIR}/zk"
CONFIG_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/config"

echo "--- JAIDE V35 Build Process Initializing ---"
echo "Root Directory: ${ROOT_DIR}"
echo "Source Directory: ${SRC_DIR}"
echo "Build Directory: ${BUILD_DIR}"

mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}"
mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog"
mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}/bin"
mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}/lib"
mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}/include"
mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}/tests"
mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}/docs"
mkdir -p "${ZK_DIR}"
mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs"
mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}/hardware_bitstreams"
mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}/formal_proofs"

echo "--- Phase 0: Environment Validation and Setup ---"
if ! command -v zig &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Zig compiler not found. Please install Zig 0.12.0 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v julia &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Julia not found. Please install Julia 1.10 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v elixir &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Elixir not found. Please install Elixir 1.15 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v ponyc &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Pony compiler not found. Please install Pony 0.58 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v nim &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Nim compiler not found. Please install Nim 2.0 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v crystal &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Crystal compiler not found. Please install Crystal 1.10 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v chpl &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Chapel compiler not found. Please install Chapel 1.32 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v futhark &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Futhark compiler not found. Please install Futhark 0.25 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v clash &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Clash HDL not found. Please install Clash 1.8 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v sbt &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: SBT not found. Please install SBT 1.9 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v yosys &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Yosys not found. Please install Yosys 0.40 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v nextpnr &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: nextpnr not found. Please install nextpnr 2023.12 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v ecppack &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: ecppack not found. Please install ecppack for ECP5."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v swipl &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: SWI-Prolog not found. Skipping Prolog compilation."
fi
if ! command -v filc &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: Filc not found. Skipping Filc compilation."
fi
if ! command -v tile &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: Tile not found. Skipping Tile compilation."
fi
if ! command -v gleam &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: Gleam not found. Skipping Gleam compilation."
fi
if ! command -v lean &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: Lean not found. Skipping Lean verification."
fi
if ! command -v agda &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: Agda not found. Skipping Agda verification."
fi
if ! command -v isabelle &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: Isabelle not found. Skipping Isabelle verification."
fi
if ! command -v tlc &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: TLC not found. Skipping TLA+ verification."
fi
if ! command -v spin &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: SPIN not found. Skipping SPIN verification."
fi
if ! command -v verifyta &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: UPPAAL not found. Skipping UPPAAL verification."
fi
if ! command -v kore-exec &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: K Framework not found. Skipping K verification."
fi
if ! command -v dedukti &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: Dedukti not found. Skipping Dedukti verification."
fi
if ! command -v circom &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: Circom not found. Skipping ZK proof generation."
fi

echo "INFO: All critical tools detected. Proceeding with build."

echo "--- Phase 1: Compiling Core Numerics Libraries (Zig) ---"
echo "  1a: Building TensorCore Library"
zig build-lib \
    -O ReleaseFast \
    -fPIC \
    -dynamic \
    -target x86_64-linux-gnu \
    --name tensor_core \
    -lc \
    -lm \
    -I "${SRC_DIR}/core" \
    "${SRC_DIR}/core/tensor_core.zig"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    mv libtensor_core.so "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libtensor_core.so" || mv libtensor_core.dylib "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libtensor_core.so"
    echo "INFO: TensorCore library built successfully."
else
    echo "ERROR: TensorCore build failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "  1b: Building Quantum Simulator Library"
zig build-lib \
    -O ReleaseFast \
    -fPIC \
    -dynamic \
    -target x86_64-linux-gnu \
    --name quantum_sim \
    -lc \
    -lm \
    -I "${SRC_DIR}/core" \
    -I "${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
    -L "${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
    -ltensor_core \
    "${SRC_DIR}/core/quantum_sim.zig"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    mv libquantum_sim.so "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libquantum_sim.so" || mv libquantum_sim.dylib "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libquantum_sim.so"
    echo "INFO: Quantum Simulator library built successfully."
else
    echo "ERROR: Quantum Simulator build failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "  1c: Building Custom Tokenizer Library"
zig build-lib \
    -O ReleaseFast \
    -fPIC \
    -dynamic \
    -target x86_64-linux-gnu \
    --name astro_tokenizer \
    -lc \
    -lm \
    -I "${SRC_DIR}/core" \
    -I "${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
    -L "${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
    -ltensor_core \
    "${SRC_DIR}/core/astro_tokenizer.zig"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    mv libastro_tokenizer.so "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libastro_tokenizer.so" || mv libastro_tokenizer.dylib "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libastro_tokenizer.so"
    echo "INFO: Astro Tokenizer library built successfully."
else
    echo "ERROR: Astro Tokenizer build failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "  1d: Building Celestial Optimizer Library"
zig build-lib \
    -O ReleaseFast \
    -fPIC \
    -dynamic \
    -target x86_64-linux-gnu \
    --name celestial_optimizer \
    -lc \
    -lm \
    -I "${SRC_DIR}/core" \
    -I "${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
    -L "${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
    -ltensor_core \
    -lquantum_sim \
    "${SRC_DIR}/core/celestial_optimizer.zig"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    mv libcelestial_optimizer.so "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libcelestial_optimizer.so" || mv libcelestial_optimizer.dylib "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libcelestial_optimizer.so"
    echo "INFO: Celestial Optimizer library built successfully."
else
    echo "ERROR: Celestial Optimizer build failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "  1e: Building Main JAIDE Runtime Library"
zig build-lib \
    -O ReleaseFast \
    -fPIC \
    -dynamic \
    -target x86_64-linux-gnu \
    --name jaide_v35 \
    -lc \
    -lstdc++ \
    -lm \
    -I "${SRC_DIR}/core" \
    -I "${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
    -L "${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
    -ltensor_core \
    -lquantum_sim \
    -lastro_tokenizer \
    -lcelestial_optimizer \
    -lfuthark_kernels \
    "${SRC_DIR}/core/jaide_runtime.zig"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    mv libjaide_v35.so "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/${LIB_NAME}" || mv libjaide_v35.dylib "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/${LIB_NAME}"
    echo "INFO: Main JAIDE runtime library built successfully."
else
    echo "ERROR: Main runtime build failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "--- Phase 2: Compiling Julia Scientific Modules ---"
echo "  2a: Setting up Julia environment"
julia -e "
using Pkg
Pkg.activate(\".\")
Pkg.add(\"LinearAlgebra\")
Pkg.add(\"Statistics\")
Pkg.add(\"Random\")
Pkg.add(\"Test\")
Pkg.add(\"FFTW\")
Pkg.add(\"SpecialFunctions\")
Pkg.add(\"Optim\")
Pkg.add(\"Distributions\")
Pkg.instantiate()
"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "INFO: Julia packages installed."
else
    echo "ERROR: Julia package installation failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "  2b: Precompiling Julia modules"
julia -e "
include(\"${SRC_DIR}/scientific/astro_lorenz_b_spline_tokenizer.jl\")
include(\"${SRC_DIR}/scientific/celestial_zo_optimizer.jl\")
include(\"${SRC_DIR}/scientific/tensor_bindings.jl\")
precompile()
"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "INFO: Julia modules precompiled."
else
    echo "ERROR: Julia precompilation failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "--- Phase 3: Building Polyglot Actor Systems and Schedulers ---"
echo "  3a: Compiling Elixir Actor System"
if [ -d "${SRC_DIR}/actors/elixir" ]; then
    cd "${SRC_DIR}/actors/elixir"
    mix local.hex --force || true
    mix local.rebar --force || true
    mix deps.get || true
    mix compile
    mix release -o "${BUILD_DIR}/bin/elixir_actors"
    cd "${ROOT_DIR}"
    echo "INFO: Elixir actor system compiled and released."
else
    echo "WARNING: Elixir actors directory not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "  3b: Compiling Pony Neural Actors"
if [ -f "${SRC_DIR}/actors/neural_actor.pony" ]; then
    ponyc \
        -release \
        -O3 \
        -o "${BUILD_DIR}/bin" \
        "${SRC_DIR}/actors"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Pony neural actors compiled."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Pony compilation failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Pony actors not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "  3c: Compiling Nim Long Recipe Scheduler"
if [ -f "${SRC_DIR}/scheduler/longrecipe.nim" ]; then
    nim c \
        --opt:speed \
        --threads:on \
        --out:"${BUILD_DIR}/bin/scheduler" \
        --verbosity:0 \
        "${SRC_DIR}/scheduler/longrecipe.nim"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Nim scheduler compiled."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Nim compilation failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Nim scheduler not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "  3d: Compiling Crystal Data Workers"
if [ -f "${SRC_DIR}/workers/data_worker.cr" ]; then
    crystal build \
        --release \
        --static \
        --no-debug \
        "${SRC_DIR}/workers/data_worker.cr" \
        -o "${BUILD_DIR}/bin/data_worker"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Crystal data workers compiled."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Crystal compilation failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Crystal workers not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "  3e: Compiling Gleam Runtime Modules"
if command -v gleam &> /dev/null; then
    cd "${SRC_DIR}/runtime" || true
    if [ -f "gleam.toml" ]; then
        gleam deps download
        gleam build --target erlang
        gleam build --target javascript
        cp -r _build/default/lib/* "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/" || true
    fi
    cd "${ROOT_DIR}"
    echo "INFO: Gleam modules built."
else
    echo "WARNING: Gleam not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "--- Phase 4: Compiling Parallel and GPU Kernels ---"
echo "  4a: Compiling Chapel Parallel Orchestrator"
if [ -f "${PARALLEL_DIR}/orchestrator.chpl" ]; then
    chpl \
        --fast \
        --no-warnings \
        --main-module orchestrator \
        "${PARALLEL_DIR}/orchestrator.chpl" \
        -o "${BUILD_DIR}/bin/parallel_orchestrator"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Chapel parallel orchestrator compiled."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Chapel compilation failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Chapel orchestrator not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "  4b: Compiling Futhark GPU Kernels"
if [ -f "${GPU_DIR}/kernels.fut" ]; then
    futhark c \
        --library \
        -o "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/futhark_kernels" \
        "${GPU_DIR}/kernels.fut"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Futhark kernels compiled."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Futhark compilation failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Futhark kernels not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "--- Phase 5: Hardware Synthesis and FPGA Deployment ---"
echo "  5a: Synthesizing Neuromorphic Core with Clash"
if command -v clash &> /dev/null && [ -f "${HARDWARE_DIR}/NeuromorphicCore.hs" ]; then
    clash \
        --verilog \
        "${HARDWARE_DIR}/NeuromorphicCore.hs" \
        -o "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/neuromorphic_core.v" \
        --top-entity FMRNNexus
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Clash synthesis complete."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Clash synthesis failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Clash or NeuromorphicCore.hs not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "  5b: Synthesizing FPGA Top Level with SpinalHDL"
if [ -d "${HARDWARE_DIR}" ]; then
    cd "${HARDWARE_DIR}"
    if [ -f "build.sbt" ]; then
        sbt "runMain jaide.hardware.FPGATop"
        if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
            mv FPGATop.v "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/" || true
            echo "INFO: SpinalHDL synthesis complete."
        else
            echo "ERROR: SpinalHDL synthesis failed."
            exit 1
        fi
    fi
    cd "${ROOT_DIR}"
fi

echo "  5c: Logic Synthesis with Yosys"
if [ -f "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/neuromorphic_core.v" ] && [ -f "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/FPGATop.v" ]; then
    yosys \
        -p "synth_ecp5 -top FPGATop -json ${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/jaide_fpga.json" \
        "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/FPGATop.v" \
        "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/neuromorphic_core.v"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Yosys synthesis complete."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Yosys synthesis failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Verilog files not found. Skipping Yosys."
fi

echo "  5d: Place and Route with nextpnr"
if [ -f "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/jaide_fpga.json" ]; then
    nextpnr-ecp5 \
        --85k \
        --json "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/jaide_fpga.json" \
        --textcfg "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/jaide_fpga.config" \
        --lpf "${HARDWARE_DIR}/constraints.pcf"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: nextpnr place and route complete."
    else
        echo "ERROR: nextpnr failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: JSON not found. Skipping nextpnr."
fi

echo "  5e: Bitstream Generation"
if [ -f "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/jaide_fpga.config" ]; then
    ecppack \
        "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/jaide_fpga.config" \
        "${BUILD_DIR}/hardware_bitstreams/jaide_fpga.bit"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Bitstream generated at ${BUILD_DIR}/hardware_bitstreams/jaide_fpga.bit"
    else
        echo "ERROR: ecppack failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Config not found. Skipping bitstream."
fi

echo "--- Phase 6: Formal Verification Suite ---"
echo "  6a: Running Prolog Knowledge Base Consultation"
if command -v swipl &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/prolog/knowledge_base.pl" ]; then
    swipl -g "consult('${VERIFICATION_DIR}/prolog/knowledge_base.pl'), verify_jaide_integrity, halt." > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/prolog.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Prolog verification passed."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Prolog verification failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/prolog.log"
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Prolog not available. Skipping."
fi

echo "  6b: Compiling and Running Filc Modules"
if command -v filc &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/filc/fmrn_filc.filc" ]; then
    filc build "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/filc/fmrn_filc.filc" -o "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libfmrn_filc.so"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Filc module compiled."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Filc build failed."
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6c: Compiling Tile Modules"
if command -v tile &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/tile/fmrn_tile.tile" ]; then
    tile compile "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/tile/fmrn_tile.tile" -o "${BUILD_DIR}/bin/fmrn_tile"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Tile module compiled."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Tile compilation failed."
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6d: Lean Neural Proofs"
if command -v lean &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/lean/neural_proofs.lean" ]; then
    lean --make "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/lean" > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/lean.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Lean proofs verified."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Lean verification failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/lean.log"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6e: Agda Type Proofs"
if command -v agda &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/agda/tensor_types.agda" ]; then
    agda --compile "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/agda/tensor_types.agda" > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/agda.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Agda proofs compiled."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Agda compilation failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/agda.log"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6f: Isabelle Security Theorems"
if command -v isabelle &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/isabelle/security_theorems.thy" ]; then
    isabelle build -d "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/isabelle" JAIDE_Security > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/isabelle.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Isabelle theorems proved."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Isabelle build failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/isabelle.log"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6g: TLA+ Consensus and Liveness Specs"
if command -v tlc &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/tla/consensus.tla" ]; then
    tlc -modelcheck -depth 100 "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/tla/consensus.tla" > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/tla_consensus.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: TLA+ consensus verified."
    else
        echo "ERROR: TLA+ consensus check failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/tla_consensus.log"
        exit 1
    fi
    tlc -modelcheck -depth 50 "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/tla/longrecipe.tla" > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/tla_longrecipe.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: TLA+ longrecipe verified."
    else
        echo "ERROR: TLA+ longrecipe check failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/tla_longrecipe.log"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6h: SPIN Neural Model Checking"
if command -v spin &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/spin/neural.pml" ]; then
    spin -a "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/spin/neural.pml"
    gcc -o "${BUILD_DIR}/bin/spin_pan" -DIMPL -DNP -DXUSERS=\"-DUSER=\" -DNSEED=12345 -DNBITS=32 -DNPROCS=3 pan.c -lpthread
    ./"${BUILD_DIR}/bin/spin_pan" -a > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/spin.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: SPIN model checking passed."
    else
        echo "ERROR: SPIN verification failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/spin.log"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6i: UPPAAL Neural Timed Automata"
if command -v verifyta &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/uppaal/neural.xml" ]; then
    verifyta -t 0 -a "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/uppaal/neural.xml" > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/uppaal.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: UPPAAL verification passed."
    else
        echo "ERROR: UPPAAL verification failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/uppaal.log"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6j: K Framework Semantics"
if command -v kore-exec &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/k/neural.k" ]; then
    kompile --backend llvm --main-module NEURAL "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/k/neural.k" -o "${BUILD_DIR}/k_build"
    kore-exec --definition "${BUILD_DIR}/k_build" --input "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/k/test_input.kore" --output "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/k_output.kore" > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/k.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: K semantics verified."
    else
        echo "ERROR: K execution failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/k.log"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6k: Dedukti Unification Proofs"
if command -v dedukti &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/dedukti/unification.dk" ]; then
    dedukti "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/dedukti/unification.dk" > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/dedukti.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Dedukti proofs checked."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Dedukti check failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/dedukti.log"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "--- Phase 7: Zero-Knowledge Proof Generation ---"
if command -v circom &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/zk/computation_proof.circom" ]; then
    circom "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/zk/computation_proof.circom" \
        --r1cs \
        --wasm \
        --sym \
        -o "${ZK_DIR}"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Circom circuit compiled."
        snarkjs groth16 setup "${ZK_DIR}/computation_proof.r1cs" "${ZK_DIR}/powersOfTau28_737_16.ptau" "${ZK_DIR}/computation_proof_0000.zkey"
        snarkjs zkey contribute "${ZK_DIR}/computation_proof_0000.zkey" "${ZK_DIR}/computation_proof_final.zkey" --name="First contribution" -v
        snarkjs groth16 export-verification-key "${ZK_DIR}/computation_proof_final.zkey" "${ZK_DIR}/verification_key.json"
        echo "INFO: ZK proving and verification keys generated."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Circom compilation failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Circom or ZK circuit not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "--- Phase 8: Unit and Integration Tests ---"
echo "  8a: Running Zig Unit Tests"
zig test "${SRC_DIR}/core/tensor_core.zig" -freference-trace
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "INFO: Zig tensor tests passed."
else
    echo "ERROR: Zig tests failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "  8b: Running Julia Integration Tests"
julia -e "
include(\"${SRC_DIR}/tests/integration_tests.jl\")
@testset \"JAIDE Integration\" begin
    @test true
end
"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "INFO: Julia integration tests passed."
else
    echo "ERROR: Julia tests failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "  8c: Running Elixir Property Tests"
if [ -f "${SRC_DIR}/tests/property_tests.exs" ]; then
    cd "${SRC_DIR}/actors/elixir"
    mix test "${SRC_DIR}/tests/property_tests.exs"
    cd "${ROOT_DIR}"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Elixir property tests passed."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Elixir tests failed."
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "--- Phase 9: Documentation Generation ---"
doxygen Doxyfile > "${BUILD_DIR}/docs/doxygen.log" 2>&1 || true
echo "INFO: Doxygen documentation generated."

echo "--- Phase 10: Packaging and Deployment Prep ---"
cp "${CONFIG_DIR}/config.json" "${BUILD_DIR}/"

#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
BUILD_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/build"
SRC_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/src"
HARDWARE_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/src/hardware"
GPU_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/src/gpu"
PARALLEL_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/src/parallel"
LIB_NAME="libjaide_v35.so"
VERIFICATION_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/src/verification"
ZK_DIR="${BUILD_DIR}/zk"
CONFIG_DIR="${ROOT_DIR}/config"

echo "--- JAIDE V35 Build Process Initializing ---"
echo "Root Directory: ${ROOT_DIR}"
echo "Source Directory: ${SRC_DIR}"
echo "Build Directory: ${BUILD_DIR}"

mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}"
mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog"
mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}/bin"
mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}/lib"
mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}/include"
mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}/tests"

mkdir -p "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs"

echo "--- Phase 0: Environment Validation and Setup ---"
if ! command -v zig &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Zig compiler not found. Please install Zig 0.12.0 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v julia &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Julia not found. Please install Julia 1.10 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v elixir &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Elixir not found. Please install Elixir 1.15 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v ponyc &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Pony compiler not found. Please install Pony 0.58 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v nim &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Nim compiler not found. Please install Nim 2.0 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v crystal &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Crystal compiler not found. Please install Crystal 1.10 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v chpl &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Chapel compiler not found. Please install Chapel 1.32 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v futhark &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Futhark compiler not found. Please install Futhark 0.25 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v clash &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Clash HDL not found. Please install Clash 1.8 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v sbt &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: SBT not found. Please install SBT 1.9 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v yosys &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: Yosys not found. Please install Yosys 0.40 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v nextpnr &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: nextpnr not found. Please install nextpnr 2023.12 or later."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v ecppack &> /dev/null; then
    echo "ERROR: ecppack not found. Please install ecppack for ECP5."
    exit 1
fi
if ! command -v swipl &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: SWI-Prolog not found. Skipping Prolog compilation."
fi
if ! command -v filc &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: Filc not found. Skipping Filc compilation."
fi
if ! command -v tile &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: Tile not found. Skipping Tile compilation."
fi
if ! command -v gleam &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: Gleam not found. Skipping Gleam compilation."
fi
if ! command -v lean &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: Lean not found. Skipping Lean verification."
fi
if ! command -v agda &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: Agda not found. Skipping Agda verification."
fi
if ! command -v isabelle &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: Isabelle not found. Skipping Isabelle verification."
fi
if ! command -v tlc &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: TLC not found. Skipping TLA+ verification."
fi
if ! command -v spin &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: SPIN not found. Skipping SPIN verification."
fi
if ! command -v verifyta &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: UPPAAL not found. Skipping UPPAAL verification."
fi
if ! command -v kore-exec &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: K Framework not found. Skipping K verification."
fi
if ! command -v dedukti &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: Dedukti not found. Skipping Dedukti verification."
fi
if ! command -v circom &> /dev/null; then
    echo "WARNING: Circom not found. Skipping ZK proof generation."
fi

echo "INFO: All critical tools detected. Proceeding with build."

echo "--- Phase 1: Compiling Core Numerics Libraries (Zig) ---"
echo "  1a: Building TensorCore Library"
zig build-lib \
    -O ReleaseFast \
    -fPIC \
    -dynamic \
    -target x86_64-linux-gnu \
    --name tensor_core \
    -lc \
    -lm \
    -I "${SRC_DIR}/core" \
    "${SRC_DIR}/core/tensor_core.zig"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    mv libtensor_core.so "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libtensor_core.so" || mv libtensor_core.dylib "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libtensor_core.so"
    echo "INFO: TensorCore library built successfully."
else
    echo "ERROR: TensorCore build failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "  1b: Building Quantum Simulator Library"
zig build-lib \
    -O ReleaseFast \
    -fPIC \
    -dynamic \
    -target x86_64-linux-gnu \
    --name quantum_sim \
    -lc \
    -lm \
    -I "${SRC_DIR}/core" \
    -I "${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
    -L "${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
    -ltensor_core \
    "${SRC_DIR}/core/quantum_sim.zig"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    mv libquantum_sim.so "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libquantum_sim.so" || mv libquantum_sim.dylib "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libquantum_sim.so"
    echo "INFO: Quantum Simulator library built successfully."
else
    echo "ERROR: Quantum Simulator build failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "  1c: Building Custom Tokenizer Library"
zig build-lib \
    -O ReleaseFast \
    -fPIC \
    -dynamic \
    -target x86_64-linux-gnu \
    --name astro_tokenizer \
    -lc \
    -lm \
    -I "${SRC_DIR}/core" \
    -I "${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
    -L "${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
    -ltensor_core \
    "${SRC_DIR}/core/astro_tokenizer.zig"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    mv libastro_tokenizer.so "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libastro_tokenizer.so" || mv libastro_tokenizer.dylib "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libastro_tokenizer.so"
    echo "INFO: Astro Tokenizer library built successfully."
else
    echo "ERROR: Astro Tokenizer build failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "  1d: Building Celestial Optimizer Library"
zig build-lib \
    -O ReleaseFast \
    -fPIC \
    -dynamic \
    -target x86_64-linux-gnu \
    --name celestial_optimizer \
    -lc \
    -lm \
    -I "${SRC_DIR}/core" \
    -I "${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
    -L "${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
    -ltensor_core \
    -lquantum_sim \
    "${SRC_DIR}/core/celestial_optimizer.zig"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    mv libcelestial_optimizer.so "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libcelestial_optimizer.so" || mv libcelestial_optimizer.dylib "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libcelestial_optimizer.so"
    echo "INFO: Celestial Optimizer library built successfully."
else
    echo "ERROR: Celestial Optimizer build failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "  1e: Building Main JAIDE Runtime Library"
zig build-lib \
    -O ReleaseFast \
    -fPIC \
    -dynamic \
    -target x86_64-linux-gnu \
    --name jaide_v35 \
    -lc \
    -lstdc++ \
    -lm \
    -I "${SRC_DIR}/core" \
    -I "${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
    -L "${BUILD_DIR}/lib" \
    -ltensor_core \
    -lquantum_sim \
    -lastro_tokenizer \
    -lcelestial_optimizer \
    -lfuthark_kernels \
    "${SRC_DIR}/core/jaide_runtime.zig"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    mv libjaide_v35.so "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/${LIB_NAME}" || mv libjaide_v35.dylib "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/${LIB_NAME}"
    echo "INFO: Main JAIDE runtime library built successfully."
else
    echo "ERROR: Main runtime build failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "--- Phase 2: Compiling Julia Scientific Modules ---"
echo "  2a: Setting up Julia environment"
julia -e "
using Pkg
Pkg.activate(\".\")
Pkg.add(\"LinearAlgebra\")
Pkg.add(\"Statistics\")
Pkg.add(\"Random\")
Pkg.add(\"Test\")
Pkg.add(\"FFTW\")
Pkg.add(\"SpecialFunctions\")
Pkg.add(\"Optim\")
Pkg.add(\"Distributions\")
Pkg.instantiate()
"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "INFO: Julia packages installed."
else
    echo "ERROR: Julia package installation failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "  2b: Precompiling Julia modules"
julia -e "
include(\"${SRC_DIR}/scientific/astro_lorenz_b_spline_tokenizer.jl\")
include(\"${SRC_DIR}/scientific/celestial_zo_optimizer.jl\")
include(\"${SRC_DIR}/scientific/tensor_bindings.jl\")
precompile()
"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "INFO: Julia modules precompiled."
else
    echo "ERROR: Julia precompilation failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "--- Phase 3: Building Polyglot Actor Systems and Schedulers ---"
echo "  3a: Compiling Elixir Actor System"
if [ -d "${SRC_DIR}/actors/elixir" ]; then
    cd "${SRC_DIR}/actors/elixir"
    mix local.hex --force || true
    mix local.rebar --force || true
    mix deps.get || true
    mix compile
    mix release -o "${BUILD_DIR}/bin/elixir_actors"
    cd "${ROOT_DIR}"
    echo "INFO: Elixir actor system compiled and released."
else
    echo "WARNING: Elixir actors directory not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "  3b: Compiling Pony Neural Actors"
if [ -f "${SRC_DIR}/actors/neural_actor.pony" ]; then
    ponyc \
        -release \
        -O3 \
        -o "${BUILD_DIR}/bin" \
        "${SRC_DIR}/actors"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Pony neural actors compiled."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Pony compilation failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Pony actors not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "  3c: Compiling Nim Long Recipe Scheduler"
if [ -f "${SRC_DIR}/scheduler/longrecipe.nim" ]; then
    nim c \
        --opt:speed \
        --threads:on \
        --out:"${BUILD_DIR}/bin/scheduler" \
        --verbosity:0 \
        "${SRC_DIR}/scheduler/longrecipe.nim"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Nim scheduler compiled."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Nim compilation failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Nim scheduler not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "  3d: Compiling Crystal Data Workers"
if [ -f "${SRC_DIR}/workers/data_worker.cr" ]; then
    crystal build \
        --release \
        --static \
        --no-debug \
        "${SRC_DIR}/workers/data_worker.cr" \
        -o "${BUILD_DIR}/bin/data_worker"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Crystal data workers compiled."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Crystal compilation failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Crystal workers not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "  3e: Compiling Gleam Runtime Modules"
if command -v gleam &> /dev/null; then
    cd "${SRC_DIR}/runtime" || true
    if [ -f "gleam.toml" ]; then
        gleam deps download
        gleam build --target erlang
        gleam build --target javascript
        cp -r _build/default/lib/* "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/" || true
    fi
    cd "${ROOT_DIR}"
    echo "INFO: Gleam modules built."
else
    echo "WARNING: Gleam not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "--- Phase 4: Compiling Parallel and GPU Kernels ---"
echo "  4a: Compiling Chapel Parallel Orchestrator"
if [ -f "${PARALLEL_DIR}/orchestrator.chpl" ]; then
    chpl \
        --fast \
        --no-warnings \
        --main-module orchestrator \
        "${PARALLEL_DIR}/orchestrator.chpl" \
        -o "${BUILD_DIR}/bin/parallel_orchestrator"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Chapel parallel orchestrator compiled."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Chapel compilation failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Chapel orchestrator not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "  4b: Compiling Futhark GPU Kernels"
if [ -f "${GPU_DIR}/kernels.fut" ]; then
    futhark c \
        --library \
        -o "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/futhark_kernels" \
        "${GPU_DIR}/kernels.fut"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Futhark kernels compiled."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Futhark compilation failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Futhark kernels not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "--- Phase 5: Hardware Synthesis and FPGA Deployment ---"
echo "  5a: Synthesizing Neuromorphic Core with Clash"
if command -v clash &> /dev/null && [ -f "${HARDWARE_DIR}/NeuromorphicCore.hs" ]; then
    clash \
        --verilog \
        "${HARDWARE_DIR}/NeuromorphicCore.hs" \
        -o "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/neuromorphic_core.v" \
        --top-entity FMRNNexus
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Clash synthesis complete."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Clash synthesis failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Clash or NeuromorphicCore.hs not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "  5b: Synthesizing FPGA Top Level with SpinalHDL"
if [ -d "${HARDWARE_DIR}" ]; then
    cd "${HARDWARE_DIR}"
    if [ -f "build.sbt" ]; then
        sbt "runMain jaide.hardware.FPGATop"
        if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
            mv FPGATop.v "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/" || true
            echo "INFO: SpinalHDL synthesis complete."
        else
            echo "ERROR: SpinalHDL synthesis failed."
            exit 1
        fi
    fi
    cd "${ROOT_DIR}"
fi

echo "  5c: Logic Synthesis with Yosys"
if [ -f "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/neuromorphic_core.v" ] && [ -f "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/FPGATop.v" ]; then
    yosys \
        -p "synth_ecp5 -top FPGATop -json ${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/jaide_fpga.json" \
        "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/FPGATop.v" \
        "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/neuromorphic_core.v"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Yosys synthesis complete."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Yosys synthesis failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Verilog files not found. Skipping Yosys."
fi

echo "  5d: Place and Route with nextpnr"
if [ -f "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/jaide_fpga.json" ]; then
    nextpnr-ecp5 \
        --85k \
        --json "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/jaide_fpga.json" \
        --textcfg "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/jaide_fpga.config" \
        --lpf "${HARDWARE_DIR}/constraints.pcf"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: nextpnr place and route complete."
    else
        echo "ERROR: nextpnr failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: JSON not found. Skipping nextpnr."
fi

echo "  5e: Bitstream Generation"
if [ -f "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/jaide_fpga.config" ]; then
    ecppack \
        "${BUILD_DIR}/verilog/jaide_fpga.config" \
        "${BUILD_DIR}/hardware_bitstreams/jaide_fpga.bit"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Bitstream generated at ${BUILD_DIR}/hardware_bitstreams/jaide_fpga.bit"
    else
        echo "ERROR: ecppack failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Config not found. Skipping bitstream."
fi

echo "--- Phase 6: Formal Verification Suite ---"
echo "  6a: Running Prolog Knowledge Base Consultation"
if command -v swipl &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/prolog/knowledge_base.pl" ]; then
    swipl -g "consult('${VERIFICATION_DIR}/prolog/knowledge_base.pl'), verify_jaide_integrity, halt." > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/prolog.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Prolog verification passed."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Prolog verification failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/prolog.log"
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Prolog not available. Skipping."
fi

echo "  6b: Compiling and Running Filc Modules"
if command -v filc &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/filc/fmrn_filc.filc" ]; then
    filc build "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/filc/fmrn_filc.filc" -o "${BUILD_DIR}/lib/libfmrn_filc.so"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Filc module compiled."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Filc build failed."
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6c: Compiling Tile Modules"
if command -v tile &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/tile/fmrn_tile.tile" ]; then
    tile compile "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/tile/fmrn_tile.tile" -o "${BUILD_DIR}/bin/fmrn_tile"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Tile module compiled."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Tile compilation failed."
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6d: Lean Neural Proofs"
if command -v lean &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/lean/neural_proofs.lean" ]; then
    lean --make "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/lean" > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/lean.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Lean proofs verified."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Lean verification failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/lean.log"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6e: Agda Type Proofs"
if command -v agda &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/agda/tensor_types.agda" ]; then
    agda --compile "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/agda/tensor_types.agda" > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/agda.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Agda proofs compiled."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Agda compilation failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/agda.log"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6f: Isabelle Security Theorems"
if command -v isabelle &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/isabelle/security_theorems.thy" ]; then
    isabelle build -d "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/isabelle" JAIDE_Security > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/isabelle.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Isabelle theorems proved."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Isabelle build failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/isabelle.log"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6g: TLA+ Consensus and Liveness Specs"
if command -v tlc &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/tla/consensus.tla" ]; then
    tlc -modelcheck -depth 100 "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/tla/consensus.tla" > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/tla_consensus.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: TLA+ consensus verified."
    else
        echo "ERROR: TLA+ consensus check failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/tla_consensus.log"
        exit 1
    fi
    tlc -modelcheck -depth 50 "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/tla/longrecipe.tla" > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/tla_longrecipe.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: TLA+ longrecipe verified."
    else
        echo "ERROR: TLA+ longrecipe check failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/tla_longrecipe.log"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6h: SPIN Neural Model Checking"
if command -v spin &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/spin/neural.pml" ]; then
    spin -a "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/spin/neural.pml"
    gcc -o "${BUILD_DIR}/bin/spin_pan" -DIMPL -DNP -DXUSERS=\"-DUSER=\" -DNSEED=12345 -DNBITS=32 -DNPROCS=3 pan.c -lpthread
    ./"${BUILD_DIR}/bin/spin_pan" -a > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/spin.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: SPIN model checking passed."
    else
        echo "ERROR: SPIN verification failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/spin.log"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6i: UPPAAL Neural Timed Automata"
if command -v verifyta &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/uppaal/neural.xml" ]; then
    verifyta -t 0 -a "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/uppaal/neural.xml" > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/uppaal.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: UPPAAL verification passed."
    else
        echo "ERROR: UPPAAL verification failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/uppaal.log"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6j: K Framework Semantics"
if command -v kore-exec &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/k/neural.k" ]; then
    kompile --backend llvm --main-module NEURAL "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/k/neural.k" -o "${BUILD_DIR}/k_build"
    kore-exec --definition "${BUILD_DIR}/k_build" --input "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/k/test_input.kore" --output "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/k_output.kore" > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/k.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: K semantics verified."
    else
        echo "ERROR: K execution failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/k.log"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "  6k: Dedukti Unification Proofs"
if command -v dedukti &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/dedukti/unification.dk" ]; then
    dedukti "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/dedukti/unification.dk" > "${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/dedukti.log" 2>&1
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Dedukti proofs checked."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Dedukti check failed. See ${BUILD_DIR}/verification_logs/dedukti.log"
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "--- Phase 7: Zero-Knowledge Proof Generation ---"
if command -v circom &> /dev/null && [ -f "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/zk/computation_proof.circom" ]; then
    circom "${VERIFICATION_DIR}/zk/computation_proof.circom" \
        --r1cs \
        --wasm \
        --sym \
        -o "${ZK_DIR}"
    if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
        echo "INFO: Circom circuit compiled."
        snarkjs groth16 setup "${ZK_DIR}/computation_proof.r1cs" "${ZK_DIR}/powersOfTau28_737_16.ptau" "${ZK_DIR}/computation_proof_0000.zkey"
        snarkjs zkey contribute "${ZK_DIR}/computation_proof_0000.zkey" "${ZK_DIR}/computation_proof_final.zkey" --name="First contribution" -v
        snarkjs groth16 export-verification-key "${ZK_DIR}/computation_proof_final.zkey" "${ZK_DIR}/verification_key.json"
        echo "INFO: ZK proving and verification keys generated."
    else
        echo "ERROR: Circom compilation failed."
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo "WARNING: Circom or ZK circuit not found. Skipping."
fi

echo "--- Phase 8: Unit and Integration Tests ---"
echo "  8a: Running Zig Unit Tests"
zig test "${SRC_DIR}/core/tensor_core.zig" -freference-trace
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "INFO: Zig tensor tests passed."
else
    echo "ERROR: Zig tests failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "  8b: Running Julia Integration Tests"
julia -e "
include(\"${SRC_DIR}/tests/integration_tests.jl\")
@testset \"JAIDE Integration\" begin
    @test true
end
"
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "INFO: Julia integration tests passed."
else
    echo "ERROR: Julia tests failed."
    exit 1
fi

echo "  8c: Running Elixir Property Tests"
if [ -f "${SRC_DIR}/tests/property_tests.exs" ]; then
